prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original square premium naturalistic painterly Mythics illustration of ATHENA as a living Olympian goddess, majestic radiant wise defender with overwhelming divine scale. Low viewpoint from the foot of the Athenian Acropolis at a stormy coast; Athena fills the square, distant classical temple columns and sea-cliffs provide tiny scale references. One human head, exactly TWO arms and TWO legs, TWO bright but natural eyes. A stately woman wearing an ornate golden CRESTED HELMET, a fully opaque long ivory robe from high neck to feet, bronze armor over the covered torso, and an AEGIS cape with real snake-shaped edging and a non-gory sculpted GORGON FACE medallion. One hand grips a long plain spear; the other bears a broad round bronze shield. Both hands clearly connected to the two arms. A small natural owl perched beside a physical olive tree at the foot of the rock are her documented symbols. Visibly embody her documented power to send a sea STORM: enormous wind-driven dark clouds gather over the grey coastal sea, towering waves and rain sweep behind her; a calm opening in the clouds casts powerful golden natural light over her helmet, dignified face and armor. This is an original mythic tableau illustrating documented Athena storm ability, not a reconstruction of a specific battle. No lightning bolts, glowing weapons, laser eyes, magical fire, energy wings or invented effects. Her expression is brave, composed and protective, not monstrous. Rich cinematic contrast, tactile painterly bronze and woven cloth, strong original silhouette, monumental grandeur; fully clothed and respectful. No nudity, exposed chest, gore, severed heads, victims, text, writing, inscriptions, border, watermark or logos. No film/game/anime/comic designs.
